summary: Supabase MCP 'lethal trifecta': support-ticket prompt injection can make an agent leak a private integration_tokens table (researcher demo)
root_cause: General Analysis demonstrated an agent with service_role access reading attacker-supplied ticket text, then writing private table contents back into the ticket. Described via Simon Willison; a research demonstration, not an in-the-wild exploit. Supabase docs recommend manual tool approval and read-only project-scoped mode.
would_have_prevented: not combining private data, untrusted input and an output channel
